use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math

let width = 480
let height = 360

let light = (x = -0.45D, y = 0.55D, z = 0.70D)

brightness(pixel_x: int, pixel_y: int) -> double =>
    (let x = (cast double(pixel_x) - 0.5D * cast double(width)) /
             (0.42D * cast double(height))
     let y = (0.5D * cast double(height) - cast double(pixel_y)) /
             (0.42D * cast double(height))

     let sky = 0.86D - 0.42D * (y + 1.2D) / 2.4D
     let away = x * x + y * y

     if away > 1.0D then
         sky
     else
         (let z = Math.sqrt(1.0D - away)
          let facing = x * light.x + y * light.y + z * light.z

          0.06D + 0.94D * Math.max(0.0D, facing))
     fi)

let source = IMAGE(width, height)
let dithered = IMAGE(width, height)

let grey = LIST[double]()

for pixel_y in 0..height do
    for pixel_x in 0..width do
        let value = brightness(pixel_x, pixel_y)
        let shade = cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * value))

        grey.add(value)
        source.set_pixel(pixel_x, pixel_y, shade, shade, shade)
    od
od

let palette = 2

nearest(value: double) -> double =>
    (let steps = cast double(palette - 1)

     Math.round(Math.min(1.0D, Math.max(0.0D, value)) * steps) / steps)

spread(pixel_x: int, pixel_y: int, error: double, part: double) is
    if pixel_x >= 0 /\ pixel_x < width /\ pixel_y < height then
        let at = pixel_y * width + pixel_x

        grey[at] = grey[at] + error * part
    fi
si

for pixel_y in 0..height do
    for pixel_x in 0..width do
        let at = pixel_y * width + pixel_x
        let wanted = grey[at]
        let chosen = nearest(wanted)
        let error = wanted - chosen

        let shade = cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * chosen))

        dithered.set_pixel(pixel_x, pixel_y, shade, shade, shade)

        spread(pixel_x + 1, pixel_y, error, 7.0D / 16.0D)
        spread(pixel_x - 1, pixel_y + 1, error, 3.0D / 16.0D)
        spread(pixel_x, pixel_y + 1, error, 5.0D / 16.0D)
        spread(pixel_x + 1, pixel_y + 1, error, 1.0D / 16.0D)
    od
od

let ink =
    (0..width * height)
        |> filter(at => dithered.pixel(at % width, at / width).red < 128ub)
        |> count()

write_line("{width} by {height}, {palette} grey levels")
write_line("{ink} of {width * height} pixels are black")

source.write("source.png")
dithered.write("dithered.png")

source.show("source.png")
dithered.show("dithered.png")
